And he's still clutching a message canister&mdash;I just hope it was worth ''this.''"<br />"See that he receives a hero's funeral, Jace, I'll get this canister to the General.|[[Jace]] and a fellow Rebel soldier, upon discovering Maraba Tev's body|<ref name="marvel51" />}}
[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Maraba Tev''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Tev accepted a high-risk intelligence-gathering mission in the [[Patriim system/Legends|Patriim system]], and uncovered information that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was developing a new [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] known as the [[Tarkin (superweapon)|''Tarkin'']]. Tev was [[Death/Legends|killed]] while rushing this information back to the Rebel [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Fleet]], but moments before his passing set his [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] on a course that allowed his body to be retrieved by his cohorts, still clutching the message canister he died to deliver.<ref name="marvel51" />
